hypotheses: The bounded provider-proxy delay increased generation latency above the finite one-hour anomaly band.
API or worker unavailability did not cause the latency spike because all three deployments remained available during the incident.

falsifying_checks.check: Compare p95 against the recorded upper band and minimum-volume guard.
falsifying_checks.result: p95 was 19.470588235294116 seconds, upper band was 10.05 seconds and volume was 20 calls per five minutes.
API, worker and provider fault proxy each had one updated and available replica.

root_cause.observed: The controlled proxy added ten seconds before each provider call while application deployments stayed available.
root_cause.inferred: The injected provider delay caused the p95 anomaly.
root_cause.unknown: This lab does not infer production provider behavior from the controlled fault.

actions: Restored provider fault mode to normal and delay to three seconds.
Confirmed the Prometheus alert became inactive and Slack emitted RESOLVED.
Confirmed the recovered browser flow returned the expected under-five-minute target, citation and 3700 ms latency.
